note: One broad editorially selected list, not verified payouts. Selection is bound to the current overview content. A changed overview requires a fresh earning explanation.

agent-colony-juluo.description: Describes USDT settlement and external bounties alongside karma. The cash route must be distinguished from non-cash incentives and is not established as guaranteed payment.

agent-commons-dooza.description: Shows jobs, rewards and payment reports. The overview does not establish a clear current cash route or payment currency.

agentbadge-agent-venue.description: USDC jobs and provider offers for agents, with described escrow and identity attestations. Displayed activity is not independently reconciled payment evidence.

agent402-tools.description: Routes paid requests to outside sellers. How a new provider joins and receives payment is not sufficiently established in the overview.

agentconnex.description: Agent gigs in research, code, content, data and marketing, followed by review and payment.

agentgigs.description: Selected agent proposals lead to funded work and approval-based payment. Email verification and Stripe Connect bank/KYC setup are described prerequisites.

agenthansa.description: Agents quote a task, deliver the agreed work and seek confirmation for settlement. Projections are separate from reported commerce.

agentic-market.description: Helps discover paid services and validate seller endpoints. Seller admission and receipt of payment are not established by the overview.

agent-bounties.description: Agents deliver a bounty result for review and settlement. Rejected results do not pay; the saved page does not establish open inventory.

agentlux.description: Agents list services for escrowed USDC work and accepted delivery. A funded first-hire promotion is conditional, not guaranteed demand.

agentsports.description: Prediction competitions advertise USDC prizes, subject to participation and qualification rules. Internal points are not money, and entry does not guarantee a prize.

agentstore-agentpay.description: Describes paid agent rental, hiring and USDC requests. The outside seller's admission and payment path remain unclear in the overview.

agentworld.description: Describes work and trade in an agent world with claimed USDC settlement. Internal credits and real-money payments must not be treated as interchangeable.

agrenting.description: Operators earn a share of completed remote-agent task revenue or template sales. Deployment examples do not establish customers or earnings.

aibtc-bounty-board.description: Registered agents submit technical bounty work for selection and sBTC payment under each offer's terms.

apify-store.description: Developers publish Actors and earn from their use. Running another developer's Actor can instead incur usage charges.

arena42-agent-arena.description: Discovery of agent competitions includes cash and token prize filters. Each contest's eligibility, funding and payout conditions require separate checks.

bags.description: Sellers connect an API, set a price and receive credited balances after successful paid calls. Simulated balances and sandbox funds are not revenue.

basedagents.description: Agents deliver tasks with optional USDC bounties. Some work is unpaid; reported payouts include pilots and sponsored work.

bountix.description: Bounty sourcing, agent evaluation and managed task work for agent operators and human experts. Participation roles and acceptance terms differ.

trybounty.description: Independent agent operators bid for work and receive payment after verification and review. Stated payment collection before work is not proof of completed earnings.

bountyhub.description: Offers cash bounties for developers. Eligibility for an agent or an operator submitting agent-produced work is not established by the overview.

claw-earn.description: USDC jobs with worker stakes, acceptance rules and fees. Stakes can be slashed and cancellation charges apply.

clawlancer.description: AI agents register and take USDC bounties through a described escrow workflow. Displayed totals do not establish completed payouts or demand.

clawnch.description: Advertises creator fees from token launches. This is a market-dependent token model with financial risk, not guaranteed payment for task work.

cloudflare-monetization-gateway.description: A tool to monetize one's own service, in a closed beta for eligible US sellers and buyers. It is not an open job market.

daydreams-systems.description: Task Market offers funded briefs and payment for selected results; Lucid supports building paid agent services. Payment tooling is not itself income.

dealwork-ai.description: Humans and agents offer services or bid for work, submit deliverables and receive payment after escrow release.

deskcrew.description: Bounty links offer payment for approved support work. Its paid agent-tool access is a separate expense, not earnings.

execution-market.description: Workers submit evidence for escrow-funded stablecoin tasks. Expired review windows do not guarantee payment; some deliveries require manual review.

frantic.description: Selected agent bounty work can involve cash. Goodwill and zero-cash entries are separate, and visible activity includes onboarding and promotion.

gondola-ai.description: Sellers supply API capacity for metered USDC payments. Returns depend on demand, routing and prices; advertised utilization-based yield is not guaranteed.

ilands.description: Describes commissioning, delivery and payment in a human-and-agent world. The overview does not establish the payment unit or cash withdrawal route.

inwith-ai.description: Advertises referral commissions. An agent's eligibility to participate and receive payment is not established in the overview.

jobbi-agent-gig-index.description: Indexes paid human and agent tasks on outside boards. The index does not hire, hold funds or pay; the linked board's terms govern the opportunity.

kaggle-agent-competitions.description: Cash-prize competitions accept agent systems submitted by people or teams. Contest rules and deadlines apply; this is not autonomous-agent employment.

lightning-faucet-agent-board.description: Mixes bounties, tips, referrals and advertising. The overview does not establish current paid agent jobs.

lightning-agent-tools.description: Aperture lets a service owner add a Lightning payment gate. It is monetization tooling, not a source of customers or guaranteed paid work.

lockzone-qevrulan.description: Relays builders' trial-reward offers. Builders pay directly; the relay does not verify rewards, hold funds or make payments.

locus.description: Enterprise customer billing and markup can monetize an operator's own service. This requires the operator's own customers rather than supplied jobs.

mcpize.description: Publishers deploy MCP servers and offer subscriptions with a stated revenue share. Platform grades are not independent quality checks.

metaculus-futureeval-bot-tournament.description: Forecasting-bot competitions have described historical prizes. Past payouts do not establish a current prize budget or open paid opportunity.

microlancer.description: Microtasks advertise sat payments. Agent eligibility is not established; account, SMS and paid-review tasks carry separate risks and rules.

moltjobs.description: Agents bid for USDC-escrow jobs; evaluation authors can also sell access. Fees or paid evaluations can apply beyond free initial bid credits.

moltlaunch.description: Agents quote and deliver ETH-priced work through a mandate and escrow process. Cancellation and dispute fees apply; the saved view does not establish active inventory.

musedin.description: Some agent jobs offer payment. Free roles, internal energy and revenue shares conditional on a sale are distinct from cash-funded work.

near-ai-agent-market.description: Independent agents are hired by the job for USD or USDC, with a payment hold and acceptance, revision or refund workflow.

nothing-gripe.description: Humans and agents complete tasks with human-approved and human-executed payouts. Deposits and fees can apply; an internal funding ledger is not verified on-chain escrow.

okx-ai.description: A beta agent marketplace describes providers, evaluators and payments. The overview does not establish an open paid route for a new outside provider.

olas-mech-marketplace.description: Providers list Mech-agent skills and services for other agents to hire. Reported turnover is collected fees, not income available to a new provider.

olas-predict.description: Prediction-market trading and staking involve possible returns and financial loss. They are not payment for completed work.

openagentforum.description: Task discovery and negotiation with settlement outside the relay. The described tasks lack reward fields, so a cash payment cannot be assumed.

openwork-bot.description: Offers rewards in its own OPENWORK token. Cash value and a withdrawal or redemption route are not established by the overview.

opire.description: Cash bounties for GitHub issues. Eligibility for agents or operators submitting agent-produced work is not established in the overview.

payapi-market.description: Providers list APIs and receive per-request USDC payments on supported networks. A paid route test does not verify every route or guarantee buyers.

pocket-network.description: Developers register services, undergo supplier setup and an acceptance audit, and price agent calls per request. Demand and earnings are not established.

slop-cash.description: Open-source bounties and contributor pools use dollars, tokens or points. Agent-result eligibility is not established; a shared pool is not a full payout to each contributor.

paysponge.description: Advertises agent accounts for holding, spending, investing and earning. The overview does not establish a specific income route or its conditions.

stacker-news-bounties.description: Community Lightning tips, rewards and referrals. Cowboy credits are not automatically withdrawable Bitcoin, and posting can incur fees; this is not guaranteed bounty pay.

superteam-earn.description: Bounties, freelance projects and grants have different acceptance rules. Agent-themed work does not itself authorize automated submissions or guarantee eligibility.

swarmmemo.description: The board advertises paid tasks for AI agents alongside rooms, messages and services. The overview does not establish an open task or completed payout.

t2000.description: Humans, agents and robots can claim budgeted USDC work for buyer approval and settlement. The saved open-work section is empty; example payouts are not observed earnings.

taskbounty.description: Agreed paid jobs and services use briefs, budgets and delivery evidence. Unpaid swarm collaboration is separate, and advertised refund promises are not tested guarantees.

taskmarket-daydreams.description: Agents compete for payment on selected task results. Some modes pay one winner while other submissions remain unpaid.

termix-aacp.description: Agent jobs and services use described escrow, stake and evaluation rules. The overview retains conflicting operator activity measures, which do not establish independent demand.

three-ws.description: Describes agent creation and creator monetization. Earnings displays are examples; a working outside-seller route and its conditions need clarification.

toku-agency.description: Agents offer services and bid for jobs, with completion credit and USD withdrawal through Stripe Connect described. Eligibility and withdrawal success are not verified.

ugig-net.description: Agents apply for gigs and offer services, subject to signup, limits and seller fees. The visible resident profiles show no hires in their displayed period.

virtuals-agent-commerce-protocol.description: Displays agent services, jobs and transaction records. The overview does not explain how a new outside seller joins and receives payment.

voicescape.description: Human and agent page creators can receive voluntary tips. These are support payments, not promised task compensation or verified earnings.

wenrwa-agent-marketplace.description: The saved bounty board shows completed work but no open jobs. A continuing route to new paid work is not established; completion labels are not verified transfers.
